visual_review: Inspected final whole wall: recognizable heavy-lidded wide-mouthed Pepe; both inherited hands each have four fingers and one thumb. New paired charcoal reed impressions occupy bare lower-left rock. No letters, numbers, signatures, logos, borders or frames added. Cave dimensions, framing, cracks, light and all ancestor marks preserved.
limitations: New marks are small and less distinct at thumbnail resolution. Visual review is local, not independent certification.
